dialogues.jp:
不必要に騒がしかった１日も終わり、晴れて学
園という名の｛おり／檻｝から解放される。
dialogues.en:
An exhausting day is finally over, and I'm released from the
jail called school.
dialogues.text:
An exhausting day is finally over, and I'm released from the
jail called school.

dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、疲れた」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I'm so exhausted."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I'm so exhausted."

dialogues.jp: 背伸びしてから、そのまま肩を落とす。
dialogues.en: I stretch my body, then my shoulders droop.
dialogues.text: I stretch my body, then my shoulders droop.

dialogues.jp: なんかどたばたと落ち着かない日だったな……。
dialogues.en: What a busy day it's been.
dialogues.text: What a busy day it's been.

dialogues.jp: 「……しかし、ひとりで下校ってのも悲しい」
dialogues.en: "But it's kinda sad to go home alone."
dialogues.text: "But it's kinda sad to go home alone."

dialogues.jp:
かったるいなぁと、もたもたしているうちに、
同じ方向に帰るやつは、あらかた消えていた。
dialogues.en:
While I've been plodding along exhaustedly, everybody who's
going in my direction has already gone.
dialogues.text:
While I've been plodding along exhaustedly, everybody who's
going in my direction has already gone.

dialogues.jp:
音夢もせっかく同じクラスになったのに、恥ず
かしがって先に帰っちゃうし……。
dialogues.en:
I'm in the same class as Nemu now, but she went home by
herself, feeling embarrassed to go home with me.
dialogues.text:
I'm in the same class as Nemu now, but she went home by
herself, feeling embarrassed to go home with me.

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、確か今日は好きなドラマの再放送だと
　か言ってたからそれだろうけど」
dialogues.en:
"Well, she said her favorite TV drama was on today, so she
had to, I guess."
dialogues.text:
"Well, she said her favorite TV drama was on today, so she
had to, I guess."

dialogues.jp:
ひとりならひとりらしく、ゆっくりとした歩調
でグラウンドを縦断して校門を出る。
dialogues.en:
I cross the field at a steady pace and walk out of the
school gate, all alone.
dialogues.text:
I cross the field at a steady pace and walk out of the
school gate, all alone.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃ〜ん！」
dialogues.en: "Oniichan~!"
dialogues.text: "Oniichan~!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ……忘れてた」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I forgot about her."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I forgot about her."

dialogues.jp:
振り返ってひょこひょこ、と揺れる髪をみつけ
て、帰宅の方向が同じやつが増えたのを思い出
した。
dialogues.en:
Turning around, I see the swinging hair that reminds me of
one person I can go home with.
dialogues.text:
Turning around, I see the swinging hair that reminds me of
one person I can go home with.

dialogues.jp: 駆け寄ってくるさくらを待つ。
dialogues.en: I wait for Sakura as she runs toward me.
dialogues.text: I wait for Sakura as she runs toward me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「｛はい／Ｈｉ｝♪　これからお帰り？」
dialogues.en: "Hi! Are you going home now?"
dialogues.text: "Hi! Are you going home now?"

dialogues.jp: 満面の笑みが俺を見上げる。
dialogues.en: She beams up at me.
dialogues.text: She beams up at me.

dialogues.jp: 「あぁ。お前も遅かったな」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I didn't know you were still here."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I didn't know you were still here."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「まだ転入の手続きとかあったし、色々な人に
　引き止められてたから」
dialogues.en:
"I had some things to do in the transfer procedure, and then
people held me up for a chat."
dialogues.text:
"I had some things to do in the transfer procedure, and then
people held me up for a chat."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃまた、人気者だな」
dialogues.en: "Oh man, you must be very popular."
dialogues.text: "Oh man, you must be very popular."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん。でも、みんなして食べ物もってきた
　り、頭をなでてくるから髪が乱れてちと困る
　……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, everybody brought me some kind of food, and stroked
my head so that my hair got messy."
dialogues.text:
"Well, everybody brought me some kind of food, and stroked
my head so that my hair got messy."

dialogues.jp: わたわた、とさくらが頭をなでる。
dialogues.en: She fixes her hair.
dialogues.text: She fixes her hair.

dialogues.jp:
それは、マスコットか珍獣の人気に近い気もす
るぞ俺は……。
dialogues.en:
It sounds like she's popular the way a mascot or an exotic
animal would be.
dialogues.text:
It sounds like she's popular the way a mascot or an exotic
animal would be.

dialogues.jp: 「で、もう帰るんだよな？」
dialogues.en: "Are you going home now?"
dialogues.text: "Are you going home now?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「イエス。お兄ちゃん一緒に帰ろう♪」
dialogues.en: "Yes. Let's go home together, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Yes. Let's go home together, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「どのみち家の方向が同じだろうが」
dialogues.en: "You know we're going the same direction."
dialogues.text: "You know we're going the same direction."

dialogues.jp:
ぶっきらぼうに言って、｛あくび／欠伸｝をこらえながら歩
き出す。
dialogues.en:
After I replied bluntly, I start walking, trying to keep
from yawning.
dialogues.text:
After I replied bluntly, I start walking, trying to keep
from yawning.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あはははは」
dialogues.en: "Ahahaha..."
dialogues.text: "Ahahaha..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ急に気持ち悪いな……」
dialogues.en: "What? Don't laugh at me."
dialogues.text: "What? Don't laugh at me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「いや、変わってないから。そのめんどくさそ
　うな歩き方とか」
dialogues.en:
"It's just, you haven't changed at all. Like the tired way
you walk."
dialogues.text:
"It's just, you haven't changed at all. Like the tired way
you walk."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうか？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく足元を見つめるが、自分の歩き方な
んて覚えてないぞ。
dialogues.en:
I look at my steps, but how do I remember the way I walked
before?
dialogues.text:
I look at my steps, but how do I remember the way I walked
before?

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「こんなだよ」
dialogues.en: "You walk like this."
dialogues.text: "You walk like this."

dialogues.jp:
俺の真似なのか、背中を丸めて、気だるそうに
さくらが隣を歩く。
dialogues.en:
Sakura imitates me by walking along hunching her back,
looking tired.
dialogues.text:
Sakura imitates me by walking along hunching her back,
looking tired.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「――って、微妙に猫背だよね？」
dialogues.en: "It's subtly hunchback, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "It's subtly hunchback, isn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……子供の頃、お前がずっと背中に張り付い
　ていたから曲がっちまったんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"When you were little, I used to carry you around on my
back. That's why I got a hunchback."
dialogues.text:
"When you were little, I used to carry you around on my
back. That's why I got a hunchback."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うわっ！　なにそれ！？」
dialogues.en: "Whoa! What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "Whoa! What do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そのまんまの意味だ」
dialogues.en: "I mean what I said."
dialogues.text: "I mean what I said."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「喧嘩売ってる！？　売ってるよね？」
dialogues.en: "You're looking for trouble, aren't you?"
dialogues.text: "You're looking for trouble, aren't you?"

dialogues.jp: 腕をまくって、さくらが拳に息を吹きかける。
dialogues.en: Sakura rolls up her sleeves and breathes on her fist.
dialogues.text: Sakura rolls up her sleeves and breathes on her fist.

dialogues.jp: 「……ぷ……あはははは！」
dialogues.en: "Puh... Ahahaha!"
dialogues.text: "Puh... Ahahaha!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうそう、それだそれだ！」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, that's it!"
dialogues.text: "Yeah, that's it!"

dialogues.jp:
なんだか嬉しくて――たしかに笑みがこぼれる
な、これは。
dialogues.en: I feel happy... This really makes me laugh.
dialogues.text: I feel happy... This really makes me laugh.

dialogues.jp:
「お前だって変わってないぞ……いや、身体と
　かじゃなくて雰囲気が」
dialogues.en:
"You haven't changed at all either... Um, I mean not your
body but your character."
dialogues.text:
"You haven't changed at all either... Um, I mean not your
body but your character."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そんなことないよ〜。一人前のレディになっ
　ていますもん」
dialogues.en: "I don't think so. I am a lady now."
dialogues.text: "I don't think so. I am a lady now."

dialogues.jp:
ツンと、どう勘違いしているのかさくらが澄ま
した表情を作る。
dialogues.en: Misunderstanding me, Sakura makes a grown-up expression.
dialogues.text: Misunderstanding me, Sakura makes a grown-up expression.

dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃん、なんて言ってるうちはまだまだ
　だ」
dialogues.en: "As long as you call me 'oniichan', you're not there yet."
dialogues.text: "As long as you call me 'oniichan', you're not there yet."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うっ……えーと、呼び方変えようか？」
dialogues.en: "Oh... Should I change the way I call you then?"
dialogues.text: "Oh... Should I change the way I call you then?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「は？　なんだ、本当に変えるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Are you serious?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Are you serious?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「兄者とか、兄貴とか……うん、いいかも♪」
dialogues.en: "Like 'anija', or 'aniki'... Yeah, it sounds good."
dialogues.text: "Like 'anija', or 'aniki'... Yeah, it sounds good."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「良くない！　頼む、今のままでいってくれ」
dialogues.en: "It doesn't! Please keep the way you've been calling me."
dialogues.text: "It doesn't! Please keep the way you've been calling me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「分かったよ兄貴！」
dialogues.en: "Understood, aniki!"
dialogues.text: "Understood, aniki!"

dialogues.jp: ピトッ、と足にはりついてくる。
dialogues.en: She clings to my legs.
dialogues.text: She clings to my legs.

dialogues.jp: 全然分かってねぇ……。
dialogues.en: I guess she has no idea what I was talking about.
dialogues.text: I guess she has no idea what I was talking about.

dialogues.jp:
こうなったら、家まではまだ時間はあるから、
たっぷりと話をつけるしかないだろう。
dialogues.en:
I have enough time to talk sense into her before we get
home.
dialogues.text:
I have enough time to talk sense into her before we get
home.

dialogues.jp: 「とりあえずだな……」
dialogues.en: "Anyhow..."
dialogues.text: "Anyhow..."

dialogues.jp: 空を見上げてため息をついた。
dialogues.en: I took a sigh, looking up at the sky.
dialogues.text: I took a sigh, looking up at the sky.

dialogues.jp: 「俺はかったりぃ」
dialogues.en: "I'm tired..."
dialogues.text: "I'm tired..."

dialogues.jp: ◆兄貴と兄者◆
dialogues.en: ◆Anija or Aniki◆
dialogues.text: ◆Anija or Aniki◆

dialogues.jp:
校門で待ち伏せしていたさくらと一緒に帰宅す
ることになる。
dialogues.en:
I found that Sakura had been waiting for me at the school
gate, and we end up going home together.
dialogues.text:
I found that Sakura had been waiting for me at the school
gate, and we end up going home together.

dialogues.jp:
かったりぃ、と呟いていると、その口癖とか猫
背とかを笑われるし、兄貴とか兄者なんて呼ば
れることになった……。
dialogues.en:
While I was mumbling about how tired I was, she laughed at
the things I said and my hunchback. And then she started to
call me 'anija' or 'aniki'.
dialogues.text:
While I was mumbling about how tired I was, she laughed at
the things I said and my hunchback. And then she started to
call me 'anija' or 'aniki'.
